fusions.name: Hard Stare
fusions.desc: Strikes the first enemy in line with a focused blast that deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Appraisal
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Strikes it from up to 7 tiles away with a blow that deals 18 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Where It Breaks
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Known Weakness
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
